nodes.name: Every 15 Minutes
nodes.notes: A heartbeat, not the schedule. The posting times live in the service (Backlog → Schedule in the console) so they can be changed without touching this workflow.

nodes.name: Tick
nodes.notes: Releases one asset for every slot that has come due. At most once per slot per local day, so ticking more often than the slots does not double-post.

nodes.name: Split Released
nodes.notes: More than one slot can come due on the same tick — after an outage, or with slots closer together than the tick interval.
